sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *néhány* (a few) and *több* (more, several) work like *sok*: the noun after them stays singular, and so does the verb. *kell* means 'is needed'. You simply name what is needed, and a quantity word can come first: *Kell egy szék.* *Több szék kell.*

sections.title: Quantity words and a singular noun

sections.content: *több* does double duty for 'more' and 'several', and either way it takes a singular noun: *több könyv*, not *több könyvek*. *sok*, *néhány* and *több* all work this way.
